# intenter summary

Count what Intenter decided, and how many prompts it answered for you

Counts the decisions of the last 24 hours: how many commands ran without a
prompt, how many of those an approval you gave once was responsible for, and
how many were asked about or refused. The approval count is the number of
dialogs that did not appear because the same question had already been
answered. Narrow it with --since, --project or --session, or widen it to
everything on record with --all.

## Usage

```text
intenter summary [flags]
```

## Examples

```console
intenter summary
intenter summary --since 72h --project ~/src/app
intenter summary --all --json
```

## Options

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--all` | — | count everything on record instead of the last 24 hours |
| `--project` `<string>` | — | only this project directory |
| `--session` `<string>` | — | only this agent session |
| `--since` `<duration>` | `0s` | count events newer than this duration, e.g. 24h |

## Options inherited from parent commands

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--config` `<string>` | — | override the configuration file path |
| `--data-dir` `<string>` | — | override the Intenter data directory |
| `--json` | — | machine-readable JSON output |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | — | verbose output |
